Proposal for Modern Web-Based Church Broadcast & Presentation System

High-Performance Multi-Screen Presentation, Tamil Bible Engine & OBS Live Stream Studio

1. Executive Summary

Blue Chip Computers LLP proposes the design, deployment, and integration of a Modern Web-Based Church Broadcast & Presentation System (PlayCast Studio). The system unifies congregation sanctuary projection, OBS Studio live streaming, pastor stage confidence monitoring, and mobile pulpit control into a single, synchronized on-premise application.

The proposed solution preserves the swift live worship workflow church media teams require, while eliminating recurring software subscription costs ($399–$999/yr) and overcoming the font corruption issues common with Tamil Unicode in legacy desktop applications.

In Summary

A mission-critical modernization of your church media infrastructure — delivering synchronized multi-screen outputs, native Tamil Bible pulling, and broadcast lower-thirds with zero internet dependency.

2. Current Challenges & Proposed Solution

2.1 Current System Limitations

Limitation in Existing Tools Operational Impact on Church Ministry
Desktop-Only & Heavy Footprint Locked to a single high-end workstation; requires heavy GPUs and tedious setup before each service.
Broken Tamil Unicode Glyphs Legacy commercial software (ProPresenter/EasyWorship) frequently clips Tamil vowel signs and ligatures.
Complex OBS Live Streaming Requires expensive NDI licenses or dual monitor capture cards, causing lag and stream desynchronization.
Expensive Add-On Stage Display Confidence TVs for pastors require separate paid software modules or third-party hardware boxes.
Internet & Cloud Licensing Fragility Cloud license validation causes presentation lockouts if church Wi-Fi or broadband drops during service.

2.2 Proposed Solution

Blue Chip Computers LLP proposes a purpose-built, browser-based broadcast system that operates completely on-premise via a lightweight local server:

  • Unified Media Operator Console: Instant search, preview cueing, and live cut transitions.
  • Synchronized Multi-Display Routing: Simultaneous feeds to Projector (1080p), OBS Stream (Alpha), and Stage TV.
  • Offline Scripture Engine: Full 31,102 verses pre-indexed in Tamil and English with sub-10ms response time.
  • $0 Recurring Fees: Complete system ownership on church-owned hardware with zero cloud subscriptions.

3. Objectives & Core Modules

3.1 Project Objectives

  • Streamline Worship Operations: Enable volunteer operators to search, stage, and display scriptures and songs in < 3 seconds.
  • Professional Broadcast Aesthetics: Deliver broadcast-standard lower thirds directly into OBS Studio with alpha transparency.
  • Native Regional Language Rendering: Provide flawless, beautiful typography for Tamil and English dual-scripture displays.
  • Fail-Safe Offline Execution: Guarantee 100% operation without reliance on active internet or external cloud servers.

3.2 Core System Modules

  • Operator Studio Workspace: Intuitive dark-mode broadcast UI with Live / Preview preview monitors, song library, and quick-cue controls.
  • Scripture Search Engine: Instant lookup across all 66 books of the Holy Bible with dual Tamil & English verse synchronization.
  • OBS Live Stream Overlay (/display): Direct URL browser source with 100% transparent background for lyric and scripture overlays.
  • Sanctuary Projector Canvas (/projector): High-resolution 16:9 fullscreen projection canvas optimized for sanctuary audiences.
  • Pastor Stage Confidence Monitor (/stage): High-contrast stage TV layout featuring current text, next slide preview, and live countdown timer.
  • Handheld Pulpit Remote (/remote): Mobile-responsive web controller allowing preachers and worship leaders to control slides wirelessly.

5. Technology Stack

The software architecture has been chosen specifically for ultra-fast startup, low hardware overhead, and rock-solid stability during live productions:

System Layer Technology Reason for Selection
Frontend Interface React 19, Vite, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS Sub-millisecond UI reactivity, typed stability, and responsive layout across monitors and tablets.
Backend Server Lightweight Portable PHP 8.3 (Built-in Web Server) Zero-dependency local runtime; requires no complex container overhead or node services on host PC.
Database Engine Embedded SQLite 3 Zero-configuration, ultra-fast disk-based SQL queries for 31,102 verses and worship song records.
Real-Time Broadcast Bridge Dual-Sync: BroadcastChannel + Local HTTP Polling Provides < 2ms same-browser sync while penetrating OBS Studio's CEF sandbox isolation.
Why This Stack

Combining modern React with portable PHP and SQLite creates an ultra-reliable, self-contained system that boots instantly from a single folder without internet access or complicated database server installations.

7. Five-Step Operational Presentation Workflow

The live workflow is engineered for high-pressure church services, enabling instant response to spontaneous preacher callouts:

Figure 2.0: Five-Step Live Presentation, Scripture Pulling & Synchronized Broadcast Pipeline
Step Operational Action Technical Execution & Response
Step 1 Preacher Announces Reference Pastor calls out scripture (e.g., John 3:16) or worship leader starts a worship song.
Step 2 Instant Offline Query Operator types book/chapter; SQLite engine queries 31,102 verses in < 10ms with zero internet.
Step 3 Preview Cues & Verification Selected slide cues onto the Studio Preview Monitor with cyan highlight for visual verification.
Step 4 Live Cut Transition Operator hits Spacebar or clicks "CUT TO LIVE", executing smooth cross-dissolve animations.
Step 5 Synchronized Broadcast Simultaneous push to OBS Studio (transparent lower third), Projector, and Stage TV.

8. Security, Reliability & Deployment

8.1 System Reliability & Fail-Safe Design

Reliability Control Operational Guarantee
100% Offline Autonomy No cloud logins, no internet checks, no external API downtime during worship.
Isolated Display Sandboxing If projector or OBS source restarts, the operator console remains completely unaffected.
Automatic State Recovery Active slide state is persistently mirrored in local SQLite; displays auto-reconnect on refresh.
Low Memory & CPU Footprint Consumes < 150MB RAM; runs comfortably on any standard dual-core church laptop.

8.2 Single-Click Church Deployment

The software is bundled with an automated launcher (start-servers.bat) that starts both the backend API and frontend broadcast server simultaneously with zero technical intervention.
